summary: Huizenga voted to advance H.Res. 1117 in April 2024, opposing one-sided pressure on Israel regarding Gaza, and voted yea on H.R. 6090 in May 2024, the Antisemitism Awareness Act directing use of the IHRA definition and examples in Title VI education-discrimination enforcement. Together these votes shield Israel from congressional scrutiny and embed the IHRA framework in federal education standards.
